Consultant / Reporting Pathologist – Agilus (SRL) Diagnostics
listings.snippet: Pan-India diagnostic chain; consultant & reporting pathologist roles, histopath/cytopath.

listings.title: Consultant Pathologist – Metropolis Healthcare (Mumbai & pan-India)
listings.snippet: Consultant Pathologist openings (Mumbai HQ + regional labs). MD Pathology, 0–5 yrs. Also reporting/region-pathologist roles.

listings.title: Consultant Pathologist – Dr Lal PathLabs (multiple cities)
listings.snippet: Consultant Pathologist roles across Delhi-NCR and other metros. Typical consultant pay band ₹15–35 LPA in the diagnostics sector.

listings.title: DrNB / FNB super-specialty pathology fellowships (NBE accredited)
listings.snippet: NBE accredits DrNB/FNB fellowships (e.g. Hemato-pathology, Molecular). Stipend paid by host hospital. Apply via NBE counselling cycles.

listings.title: Fellowship in Histopathology / Cytopathology – TMC Kolkata
listings.snippet: Post-MD fellowships in Histopathology & Cytopathology at a dedicated cancer centre.

listings.title: Fellowship / SR – Hematopathology & Pathology, ACTREC (Navi Mumbai)
listings.snippet: ACTREC offers paid SR-fellowship posts in Hematopathology & Pathology (molecular onco). Research-heavy.

listings.title: Fellowship: Hematopathology & Molecular Hemato-Oncology – TMH (paid, ~₹1.21 L gross)
listings.snippet: 1-yr TMH fellowship in Hematopathology + Molecular Hemato-Oncology, then peripheral posting. Gross pay ~₹1,21,200/month. Also Surgical Path & Cytopathology fellowships.

listings.title: Senior Resident / Onco-Pathology – GCRI Ahmedabad
listings.snippet: GCRI recruits SR & onco-pathology roles. Cancer-focused histopathology exposure.

listings.title: Senior Resident (Pathology) – B.J. Medical College, Ahmedabad
listings.snippet: Large PG institution; SR Pathology posts via Gujarat govt / college notices.

listings.title: Senior Resident / Resident Pathologist – KEM-GSMC Mumbai
listings.snippet: KEM (GSMC) Dept of Pathology recruits SR / Resident Pathologist. High-volume teaching hospital.

listings.title: Senior Resident (Pathology) – TMC Mumbai (~₹1.01–1.10 L/month)
listings.snippet: TMC recruits SR Pathology; pay ~₹1.01–1.10 L/month. MD Pathology. Onco-pathology exposure. Watch job-vacancies page.

listings.title: Senior Resident – NIMHANS (Neuropathology / Lab Medicine)
listings.snippet: NIMHANS recruits SR including Neuropathology & Lab Medicine. Strong subspecialty exposure.

listings.title: Senior Resident (Pathology) – JIPMER
listings.snippet: JIPMER recruits SR across specialties incl. Pathology. INI; competitive.

listings.title: Senior Resident (Pathology) – AIIMS Bhopal (online application cycles)
listings.snippet: AIIMS Bhopal runs large SR online-application drives (e.g. 128 posts). Pathology among departments. MD/MS/DNB.

listings.title: Senior Resident (Pathology) – PGIMS Rohtak / UHS
listings.snippet: Haryana faculty + SR recruitment runs through UHS Rohtak. Pathology posts appear in the omnibus medical-college notifications.

listings.title: Senior Resident (Pathology) – KCGMC Karnal
listings.snippet: KCGMC (affiliated PGIMS Rohtak) recruits SR/Tutor-Demonstrator incl. Pathology. MD/MS/DNB; diploma/3-yr PG experience accepted if MD unavailable.

listings.title: Senior Resident recruitment – GMC Patiala
listings.snippet: Periodic SR recruitment across departments. Check for Pathology in the latest advertisement.

listings.title: Senior Resident (Pathology) – BFUHS / GGS Medical College Faridkot
listings.snippet: BFUHS & affiliated Punjab govt colleges recruit SR (MD Pathology) via direct interview. Watch University Recruitment page.

listings.title: Senior Resident / Tutor Specialist (Pathology) – IGMC Shimla
listings.snippet: Direct recruitment of SR/Tutor Specialists. Non-clinical (Pathology) per HP Medical Education Service rules. Bond/field-posting rules may apply.

listings.title: Senior Resident / Senior Demonstrator (Pathology) – AIIMS New Delhi
listings.snippet: AIIMS holds an SR recruitment exam (Residency Scheme, ad-hoc tenure). Pathology among specialties. Apply via aiimsexams portal.

listings.title: Senior Resident (incl. Pathology) – VMMC & Safdarjung
listings.snippet: Large SR intake across departments including Pathology. Watch the Recruitment page for dated notices/walk-ins.

listings.title: Senior Resident (Pathology) – ICMR-NIP, Safdarjung campus
listings.snippet: ICMR-NIP invites SR (Pathology) with MD/DNB/DCP completed within last 3 yrs. Located on Safdarjung Hospital campus, New Delhi.

listings.title: Senior Resident (Pathology / Immunopathology) – Walk-in Interview
listings.snippet: PGIMER recruits SR Pathology via walk-in. MD Pathology required; some calls want Immunopathology experience.

listings.title: Walk-in: Senior Resident / Resident Pathologist (Pathology) – ~₹67,700 + 20% NPA
listings.snippet: GMCH-32 holds frequent walk-in interviews for SR & Resident Pathologist. Level-11 (7th CPC) + NPA. Check site for the next dated notice.
